tickerText: [TENNIS] Nitto ATP Finals close Sunday in Turin as Carlos Alcaraz meets Alexander Zverev for the title after Alcaraz rallied past Ben Shelton 3-6, 6-3, 7-6(1) and Zverev topped Daniil Medvedev 7-6(0), 6-4 in Saturday semis • [SQUASH] PSA China Open finals Sunday in Shanghai send top seed Mostafa Asal against Mohamad Zakaria in an all-Egyptian men's title match while S. Sivasangari faces Satomi Watanabe for the women's crown at 7 p.m. • [BADMINTON] LI-NING Hong Kong Open finals Sunday at Kai Tak open at 1:30 p.m. with Wang Zhiyi–Pornpawee Chochuwong, Anders Antonsen–Kunlavut Vitidsarn, and an all-China Feng Yanzhe–Huang Dongping vs Jiang Zhenbang–Wei Yaxin mixed clash • [PICKLEBALL] Proton Daytona Beach Open Championship Sunday at Pictona starts at 10 a.m. with all five pro finals, including Federico Staksrud–Hunter Johnson in men's singles and Ben Johns–Anna Leigh Waters in mixed • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Star Contender Muscat finished Saturday in Oman as Shunsuke Togami beat Park Ganghyeon for men's singles, Honoka Hashimoto edged Kaho Akae for women's, and Japan also swept mixed and women's doubles

newsItems.title: Turin Title Sunday
newsItems.excerpt: Carlos Alcaraz and Alexander Zverev meet in Sunday's Nitto ATP Finals championship after Alcaraz came from a set down to beat Ben Shelton and Zverev stayed undefeated with a straight-sets win over Daniil Medvedev.

newsItems.title: Kai Tak Finals Day
newsItems.excerpt: Five HSBC BWF World Tour Super 500 titles are on the line at Kai Tak Arena, headlined by Anders Antonsen versus Kunlavut Vitidsarn in men's singles and defending champion Wang Zhiyi against Pornpawee Chochuwong in women's singles.

newsItems.title: Daytona Title Sunday
newsItems.excerpt: Championship Sunday at the Carvana PPA Proton Daytona Beach Open locks in five pro finals at Pictona, with Federico Staksrud facing Hunter Johnson in men's singles and Ben Johns pairing Anna Leigh Waters in mixed doubles.

newsItems.title: Muscat Japan Sweep
newsItems.excerpt: Japan dominated the weekend finale in Muscat as Shunsuke Togami and Honoka Hashimoto won singles titles and Togami teamed with Satsuki Odo for mixed gold on the Star Contender's last day of play.
